trust_zones.public_web_ui: static application shell only; no business API authorization
trust_zones.public_identity: identity protocol endpoints; authentication cannot precede login

policy_contract.external_tls_boundary: external load balancer or ingress; evidence required before G2
policy_contract.tenant_identity: trusted authenticated claim only; request tenant headers are not authoritative
policy_contract.timeout_and_retry: explicit per route; mutation retries require idempotency proof
policy_contract.audit: gateway access trace plus transactional service audit for business mutations
policy_contract.rollout: content-hashed shadow, internal tenant canary, atomic previous-hash rollback
